transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, I'm here because my head just feels... foggy lately. I keep mixing up really simple things. Like, I'll get confused about appointment times, or dates for different exhibits, or even which of the volunteers I've already called. It's just very frustrating.
Do you find it hard to remember things from day to day, or do you feel confused about where you are or what day it is sometimes?

No, I don't think it's quite like that. I mean, I always know where I am, and I know what day of the week it is. I'm not getting lost or anything. It's really just... what I mentioned before, mixing up the specific details and the schedules. My memory from day to day is mostly fine otherwise, it's just those little things getting jumbled.
Have you noticed any trouble finding the right words when you speak, or difficulties with problem-solving, like managing finances or planning events?

No, I haven't really noticed anything like that. Finding my words is usually fine. I mean, I can hold a conversation without getting stuck. And as for my bills and the checkbook... no, I do all that myself without any trouble. It's not that I can't figure things out or plan, it's really just... well, just those little mix-ups with the schedules I mentioned before.
Have you noticed any changes in how you perceive things visually, like judging distances, reading, or recognizing familiar objects?

No, my vision seems fine. I mean, I wear my glasses for reading, but that's nothing new. I don't have any trouble recognizing things or figuring out how far away something is. It's really just the confusion with the dates and times that's been bothering me.
Have you ever had a period of heavy alcohol use or used any other substances that might affect your memory or thinking?

No, I've never been much of a drinker at all. I might have a glass of wine at a wedding or a special occasion, but definitely no heavy drinking. And I've never touched any other kind of drugs or substances, either.
Have you ever had any neurological issues, like headaches, seizures, or weakness on one side of your body, or has anyone ever mentioned you should get checked for something like that?

No, nothing like that. I don't get bad headaches, and I've certainly never had a seizure or anything. No weakness, either. My doctor's never brought up anything neurological, so... no, I've never had to be checked for any of that.
Lately, have you been feeling down, sad, or have you lost interest in activities that you used to enjoy?

Yes, I have. It's... well, things I used to really love doing just don't appeal to me right now. Like my watercolors, or tending to my tomato plants—they just sit there now. I used to go line dancing, and I always enjoyed watching the cardinals out back, but lately, I just can't make myself care about any of it.
How often have you felt this way about your usual activities—like your watercolors or tending to your tomato plants? Has it been most days, and does it last throughout the day?
Well, it's been pretty much every day. I'd say for the last couple of weeks, at least. I wake up feeling that way, and it just stays with me all day long. I just can't seem to shake it off.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately, or do you have trouble sleeping even when you're tired?

Well, my appetite hasn't been great. Most days I just kind of pick at a piece of toast or maybe have a little soup, because nothing really sounds good to me. And I have noticed my skirts are getting pretty loose lately, even though I haven't been trying to lose any weight. As for sleeping, yes, I'm tired, but I just toss and turn a lot of the night.
Would you say that you feel down or sad most of the time, not just when you're dealing with the mix-ups or frustration with your schedule?

Well, honestly, I don't really feel sad. It's more just... I don't know, empty, I guess? Like I said, I just don't have the energy to care about my plants or my painting, but I wouldn't say I'm sitting around crying or feeling down in the dumps. I just feel kind of blank most of the day.
Have you noticed any difficulty with thinking clearly or concentrating on tasks lately?

Yes, actually, that's really what brought me in to see you. My head just feels... foggy. I keep mixing up really simple things. Like, I'll get my appointment times wrong, or I'll confuse the dates for exhibits. I even forget which volunteer I've already called on the phone. It's just been very hard to keep my thoughts straight lately.
Have you found that you no longer take pleasure in things you used to enjoy, like your painting or gardening, even a little bit?

Yes, that's exactly it. Things I used to really love doing... well, they just sit there now. My watercolors, my tomato plants... I used to go line dancing too, and I always liked watching the cardinals out in the back yard. But lately, I just can't seem to make myself care about any of it, not even a little bit.
Have you noticed that you've been moving more slowly than usual, or have you felt restless or fidgety lately?

Well, I'm definitely not restless. It's more... well, my husband says I move like I'm wading through mud now. Everything just feels so heavy. Even just getting up from the chair to answer the phone or, you know, go sort the mail... it just takes me a long time to get going.
